purpose: Isolated local end-to-end preproduction for the e-invoicing module
environment: Load only the manifest.environment object into the Next process environment. Never copy it into Git or a production environment. NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and ANON_KEY both refer to the local JWT. Stripe and cron credentials are explicitly empty.
restart: The database is deliberately in-memory and rebuilt from migrations on each gateway restart. Source IDs are always replaced in the private manifest. Credentials are regenerated by default, requiring Next to reload the environment. The explicit --reuse-local-credentials option reuses only a strictly matching local manifest, so the Next environment can remain unchanged; old Auth sessions must still sign in again. No production state is read or modified.

authentication.kind: Explicit test double; not Supabase Auth
accounts: local administrator of a separate tenant

database.engine: Real PostgreSQL via isolated in-memory PGlite
database.migrations: Shared test bootstrap, actual commercial/security migrations 097 through 102, and notification schema 047
database.execution: Every request runs in a serialized real SQL transaction with a role and bound JWT subject. RLS and function grants are enforced by PostgreSQL. RPC arguments are typed from pg_proc and parameterized; no raw SQL endpoint exists.
database.historicalSchemaLimitation: The repository lacks the original accounting table-creation migration; the shared test bootstrap explicitly constructs its relevant columns. This harness does not claim to reproduce a complete production database snapshot.
fixtures: one validated customer invoice with discount and three tax rates including a zero-rate line requiring a stated reason
one validated customer credit note linked to that invoice
one separate tenant and source invoice
fictitious bilingual seller and buyer fiscal identities
database.fiscalIdentities: All identities and tax identifiers are artificial fixtures and must never be transmitted to a tax authority.

httpScope.read: An explicit allowlist of app-shell and e-invoicing tables/views with a limited PostgREST projection/filter/pagination adapter
httpScope.write: Only einvoice_* RPCs, the read-only get_commercial_document_usage RPC, and parameterized app_notifications inserts under their actual SQL role/RLS; unrelated RPCs and raw financial table writes are unavailable
httpScope.namedFixtureHooks: Loopback/service JWT only, target organization fixed by the seed: advance-retries changes availability only for its retry_wait jobs; subscription-state expires or restores the exact original local subscription dates. These hooks exist only in this harness and are never deployed.
httpScope.limitations: This is not a full PostgREST implementation. Unsupported operations return a visible harness error instead of fabricated business data.
httpScope.network: Gateway binds only loopback and makes no external HTTP requests. HTTP probes reject any SDK destination outside the exact gateway origin.
